description:
ABHYUDAYA 2026

RISE THROUGH INNOVATION

GEC HACKFEST | 8-HOUR HACKATHON

Welcome to ABHYUDAYA 2026 – GEC HACKFEST!

Government Engineering College, Challakere, affiliated with Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), invites students to participate in an exciting 8-hour hackathon. Bring your ideas to life, work with your team, solve real-world problems and showcase your innovation!

** Participation Guidelines**
1. Participation is strictly limited to students of Government Engineering College, Challakere.
2. Each team must have a minimum of 2 and a maximum of 4 members.
3. Every team must have one designated Team Leader.
4. Only one registration per team is required.
5. All team members must provide correct academic and contact details.
6. Participants must bring their own laptops and other required accessories.
7. Participants must submit their PPT of their solution to the selected problem in provided whatsapp group before 30/11/2026

**Hackathon Rules & Guidelines**
1. No pre-written code or ready-made projects are allowed. All coding must be done during the hackathon.
2. No outside programmers or external help are allowed during the event.
3. Participants must develop their projects within the given 8-hour time limit.
4. Using existing libraries, frameworks and open-source tools is allowed.
5. Copying projects or code from other teams is strictly prohibited.
6. Teams must be ready to explain and demonstrate their projects to the judges.
7. Any form of cheating or violation of the rules may lead to disqualification.
8. The judges' decision will be final.

ABHYUDAYA 2026

RISE THROUGH INNOVATION
Where Young Minds Turn Ideas into Impact!

ABHYUDAYA 2026 | GEC HACKFEST
